description: Hualien Earthquake - EERI VERT Phase 1 Report is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Erica Fischer, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). EERI VERT's Phase 1 report provides an overview of the damage and specific information for four heavily damaged reinforced concrete buildings in Taiwan. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2MH5T. Keywords: earthquake, Taiwan, reinforced concrete. Published 2018-12-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
